cards.title: 💻 About Me
cards.content: I completed my Bachelor of Technology in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning from Buddha Institute of Technology, Gorakhpur, affiliated with Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow. I am a passionate and detail-oriented developer with a strong interest in building modern web applications and AI-ML based solutions. I am always eager to learn new tools, enhance my skills, and develop user-friendly and impactful applications.

cards.title: 🎯 Career Objective
cards.content: To work in an organization where I can apply my knowledge and skills to contribute to organizational goals, deliver highquality results, and create value for the organization.
